notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Hello Playtesters!
This update brings new art assets for the depot, environment, and the Sweeper vehicle! We've also been hard at work on road and sidewalk generation code. While the sidewalks aren't quite ready for this build, they're coming soon.
What's New & Fixed:
[list]
[*] New Art Assets - Fresh WIP visuals for the Depot and updated Sweeper vehicle design
[*] Wide Sweep Head Upgrade - New upgrade option available!
[*] Cleaning Power System - Upgrade your sweep heads' cleaning power to clean more effectively, letting you drive faster and revisit spots less often
[*] Modular Sweep Heads - Sweep heads are now upgradeable with more options coming in future updates
[*] Improved Road Connections - Better road segment joins when connecting to other roads (roundabout issues still being worked on)
[*] Vehicle Reset Button - Added to the menu for your convenience incase of accidents
[*] Vehicle Adjustments - Slightly reduced vehicle length for better handling
[*] Depot Improvements - Added a rolling door to the Depot
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed money and inventory doubling when starting a new game
[*]Fixed cruise control always increasing to 7km/h when brushes are deployed
[*]Fixed engine light incorrectly showing green when engine is off

[/list]
The majority of our work is now focused on preparing an upcoming demo for Steam Next Fest!
Thanks for your continued feedback and support! Keep those reports coming.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Thank you to all who have played so far. We've received some great feedback and implemented several changes in this build:
[list]
[*] Added feedback link buttons to menu
[*] Implemented storage capacity for the Sweeper. There's now a limit on the amount of trash it can hold. Returning to the Depot and emptying will reset it. The default indicator is up on the left side of the dash and will warn you when it's at 85% capacity or full. A more advanced indicator upgrade is in the works.
[*] Implemented cruise control as an upgrade. Can be toggled with 'C' once installed.
[*] Added stat displays of what upgrades do in the upgrade screen. For example, the Turbo Drive Engine adds +50 to engine power. These effects will now show in the item list.
[*] Trash items on the ground can be manually picked up and put into the front of the sweeper through physics dragging. Look at the item and hold Left Mouse Button to pick it up.
[*] Fixed issue with saving the player's inventory and upgrades, which should now properly save between sessions.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support and feedback!
